archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO (Adapted for Music Data)

rules: CRITICAL: Do NOT use Inter, Space Grotesk, Roboto, or Open Sans.
Financial figures must use tabular-nums for vertical alignment.
Use text-zinc-50 for primary data points, text-zinc-400 for labels.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Flat solid backgrounds. Max 8px border-radius (rounded-lg). NEVER nest cards within cards.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px subtle inner stroke (border-white/10) on all cards to separate from background.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Use ambient glow for active states, flat dark otherwise.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used ONLY for sticky headers. bg-zinc-950/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10. NEVER use fully transparent headers.

grids_and_layouts.global_padding: Generous. Use p-6 or p-8 inside containers.
grids_and_layouts.dashboard_grid: High Density Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-4 or gap-6.
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Left-align all text, data, and charts. Never center-align dashboard metrics.
grids_and_layouts.mobile_first: Always stack widgets vertically on mobile (grid-cols-1). Ensure charts have horizontal scrolling if they exceed width.

component_strategy.buttons: Pill-shaped or slightly rounded (rounded-md). Subtle hover translation (-translate-y-[1px]).
component_strategy.dropdowns: Shadcn Select. Solid bg-zinc-900. No transparent backgrounds.
component_strategy.tables: Flat tables with border-b border-white/5. Hover state: bg-white/5.
component_strategy.charts: Shadcn Charts (Recharts). Use monochrome blue tones for streams, green for revenue to avoid clutter. No grids on charts, minimalist axes.
component_strategy.empty_states: Crucial. Display dashed border container (border-dashed border-zinc-700) with a subdued Lucide icon and text 'Belum ada data laporan'.

header.title: Dashboard Analitik Label
header.controls: Select Dropdown for period (Bulan Terbaru, 6 Bulan, 12 Bulan)

motion_and_interaction.hover: All interactive elements must explicitly state hover text color (e.g., hover:text-white).
motion_and_interaction.transitions: Use specific transitions like transition-colors, transition-transform duration-200. NO transition-all.
motion_and_interaction.loading: Use skeleton loaders (animate-pulse bg-zinc-800) matching exactly the widget sizes.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 for text. Hover states must have higher contrast.
accessibility_and_testing.data_testid: CRITICAL: Add data-testid to every button, link, select, tab, and card. Example: data-testid='period-selector-dropdown', data-testid='metric-total-pendapatan'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the dashboard using React (.jsx/.js) and Tailwind CSS. Do NOT use .tsx.
Implement Shadcn UI for the charts, select, and cards, but strip heavy Vercel-look borders in favor of the flat dark design rules.
Ensure the dashboard handles 'no data' gracefully (since reports are uploaded via CSV by admin).
Avoid nested Shadcn <Card> components. Use plain <div className='p-6 bg-zinc-900 rounded-lg border border-white/10'> for better layout control.
Include lucide-react icons for visual anchors (e.g., Music, MapPin, Play, DollarSign).
Keep terminology in Indonesian as per user request.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Break standard grid symmetries slightly if it aids hierarchy.
Never center align the main app container. Always maintain left alignment for data.
Use 2-3x more spacing (p-6, p-8) between discrete widgets.
Use 'sonner' for toast notifications, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js
Do not use AI emoji characters. Rely strictly on lucide-react or Phosphor Icons.
